Choose: EU-hosted only, or any host with a data processing agreement
Tell the next session (E7, S54)

python run_pipeline.py --only rating_v5_profile

Change or add ids, then run `--bless`

how: On the box add `CARTA_QUALITY_OUT=logs/status/quality` to the environment the timers use, then once `mkdir -p logs/status/quality && cp data/reports/quality/* logs/status/quality/`

title: Confirm the rules
why: Which fields are must_see (hard, gated on a 2 point drop) and the floors are my call from what each card and page shows.
how: Read `scripts/quality/rules.yaml` (the comment on each line is the share the floor was set from)
Change `level`, `kind` or `min`, or ask a session to

Tell the next session which

The Pages build per CLAUDE.md Deploy (preview first)
On the preview run one plan-day day, one town suggestion and one magic import and check each answer's `meta.model` and `meta.guard`, and ask one Ask question

Do not open `sample-key.json`
Fill `by` and `at`
Then `cd continent-app && node scripts/eval/run.mjs plan-day --write --dashboard` and commit `labels.json`, `data/reports/evals/` and `docs/reference/evals.md`

title: Run the Gemini judge once
why: A second judge to compare with the session judge.
how: On a machine with the pipeline's `GEMINI_API_KEY`: `cd continent-app && CARTA_JUDGE_MODEL=<a model outside plan-day's chain> node scripts/eval/plan-day/judge.mjs --backend gemini`, then `node scripts/eval/run.mjs plan-day --write --dashboard`, commit `judgments/` and the results

title: Deploy the prompt registry
why: The Edge Functions and Ask load their prompts from the bundled registry module only once deployed; the prompts are unchanged.
how: With T1137-a: `supabase functions deploy plan-day`, `supabase functions deploy suggest-city`, `supabase functions deploy parse-booking`, then the Pages build per CLAUDE.md Deploy (preview first)
On the preview run one plan-day day, one town suggestion, one magic import and one Ask question and check each answers as before

title: Reranker live check (E-R2)
why: Workers AI is not reachable from the cloud container.
how: For 20 E1 questions per language, take the top 30 passages of the current path, then run `curl -s -o out.json -w '%{time_total}\n' https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/$CF_ACCOUNT_ID/ai/run/@cf/baai/bge-reranker-base -H "Authorization: Bearer $CF_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"query":"quiet lake village","contexts":[{"text":"<passage 1>"},{"text":"<passage 2>"}],"top_k":10}'` (check the response wrapper on the first call), re-order, score nDCG@10 and recall@5 with `scripts/eval/ask-eval-lib.mjs`

Time p50 and p95 over 200 calls from a deployed Worker with `env.AI.run`, since curl adds your own link. Go only on +0.03 nDCG@10 for free-text questions, no drop on facet questions, added p95 at most 300 ms

title: Rebuild and bless the full index
why: The index is not in git or the container.
how: In the main checkout `python run_pipeline.py ask_index` (it runs `build-ask-bm25.mjs`), confirm the log line for `bm25.json` stays under 400 KB gzip and lists `bm25-beach.json`, `bm25-lake.json`, `bm25-peak.json`, then `cd continent-app && node scripts/eval/ask-eval.mjs --check` (expect sparse, dense and hybrid to run) and `--bless`, and commit `scripts/eval/ask-baseline.json`

title: Review the taxonomy before labelling
why: The labels and the S66 tagger both use this vocabulary, so changes are cheapest now.
how: Read the node tables at the end of `docs/ai/taxonomy-labelling-guide.md` and the `not_a_concept` blocks in `pipeline/taxonomy/mapping.yaml`

Add, merge or rename nodes in `pipeline/taxonomy/carta_taxonomy.yaml` (keep ids stable, bump `version`), then `python -I pipeline/taxonomy/taxonomy.py check` and `python -m pytest tests/test_taxonomy.py -q`

title: Label the 400 items
why: P@5 and F1 on 400 labelled items is the F1 done condition.
how: Open `continent-app/scripts/eval/taxonomy/gold.csv` in a spreadsheet, follow `docs/ai/taxonomy-labelling-guide.md` (every true tag, most specific node, skip the data-rule nodes

About 40 hours at ten items an hour), save as UTF-8 CSV with the same columns, then `cd continent-app && node scripts/eval/run.mjs taxonomy --write --dashboard` and commit `gold.csv`, `data/reports/evals/` and `docs/reference/evals.md`

`python pipeline/provenance.py --count app_data/app_data.json` (expect 0 stamped)
`python pipeline/provenance.py --backfill app_data/app_data.json`

Only if the verifier lifts R-precision at 5 or micro F1, run `python -I pipeline/taxonomy/tagger.py --all --verify` on the box (about 26,000 calls, see T1150-e)

Keep `--dense` in the `taxonomy_tags` task in run_pipeline.py only if R-precision at 5 or recall at 10 rises

title: Feed the SLO panel
why: The panel is empty until a snapshot exists.
how: Give a task the GitHub token, Sentry token and Supabase service key it needs for the collector
Run it weekly on the box
Commit or push the snapshot

title: Run the live incident drill
why: Proves the page reaches your phone and the notice works.
how: Follow the Live steps in incident.md, note the times in drill-log.md

title: Push a trailslab dump the worker can open
why: The worker restores only a dump encrypted to its key, and the laptop lab is the only copy.
how: Start the lab (cd tools/trailslab && docker compose up -d)
On the box make the worker public key without touching its keyring (h=$(mktemp -d)
Gpg --homedir $h --batch --import ~/.config/carta/trailslab-worker.sec.asc
Gpg --homedir $h --armor --export > worker.pub.asc
Rm -rf $h) and copy worker.pub.asc to the laptop

There, in WSL or Git Bash with a PostgreSQL 18 client, gpg and rclone's r2 remote: CARTA_BACKUP_KEY=<your key id> CARTA_WORKER_GPG_PUBLIC_FILE=worker.pub.asc bash infra/hetzner/cax41/trailslab_dump.sh push

title: Build the Ask index and guided search on the box
why: Removes the last ML steps from the laptop.
how: Add CARTA_BOX_ML=all to ~/.config/carta/env
The next monthly run installs model2vec and ~/venv-guided (check df -h after, about 1 GB)
After it: grep -E "ask_index|guided_search|golden total" ~/carta/logs/pipeline_run.log and free -m during a run

title: Switch on the stays scrape for Hostelworld on the box
why: The March scrape no longer needs the laptop.
how: Give the box's R2 token write access to the carta-stays-state bucket (Cloudflare dashboard, R2, API tokens)
Sudo ~/venv/bin/python -m playwright install-deps chromium
Sudo bash infra/hetzner/cron/install.sh
Test one town: CARTA_STAYS_SCRAPE=1 FORCE=1 STAYS_RUN=2026-11 bash infra/hetzner/cax11/stays_scrape.sh -- --only FLR and read ~/carta/logs/stays_hostelworld.log for rows or a block
If it passes, set CARTA_STAYS_SCRAPE=1 in ~/.config/carta/env before March

title: Choose where Booking scrapes
why: Booking turns away datacenter addresses, so the box cannot do it.
how: Decide: a home device (recommended, about EUR 130 to 150 once) or a residential proxy (about USD 16 to 240 a year)

On a home Linux device: clone the repo, a Python 3.12 venv with requirements.txt, apt-get install xvfb, the rclone r2 remote, then CARTA_STAYS_SCRAPE=1 CARTA_STAYS_SITES=booking CARTA_STAYS_BOOKING_EGRESS=residential and the two carta-stays-scrape units
Turn off the laptop's CartaStayScrape task after the first good March night

title: Decide whether the worker promotes approved trips
why: Until then approved trips reach the wire only through the laptop's trails_rate run.
how: After one worker run with --no-install has passed: set CARTA_TRAILSLAB_PROMOTE=1 in ~/.config/carta/env
After the next worker run read logs/trailslab_worker/<run>/out/MANIFEST.txt (promoted=N) and reports/logs/rows_check.log

title: Delete the stale continent-app/.git
why: It shows hundreds of false changes and a commit made there is lost; ship and worktree.mjs warn while it exists.
how: In the root checkout run `git -C continent-app log -1 --oneline` to confirm it is the T915 master with no remote
Delete the folder `continent-app\.git` (only that folder)
Run `node scripts/ship.mjs --check` and see "no stale continent-app/.git"

title: Prove worktree.mjs on Windows with a junction
why: Junctions are where the old deletes happened, and this container could only test symlinks.
how: Run `node scripts/worktree.mjs add t1162-proof --base main --link-node-modules`
Note the count of `continent-app\node_modules` entries in the main checkout
Run `node scripts/worktree.mjs remove t1162-proof --force`
Check the count is unchanged and delete the branch `p15-t1162-proof`

title: Ship the next deploy with the script
why: One command that stops on any failed step replaces six by hand.
how: From the root checkout on main run `node scripts/ship.mjs` (dry run) and read the warnings
Run `node scripts/ship.mjs --live`
If a step fails, fix it and rerun with the printed `--from <step>`
Type "delete" at the prune

title: Scan the preview with ZAP
why: The CI gate has only seen a local preview; the real headers come from Cloudflare's edge and can differ.
how: Deploy the preview as usual
GitHub, Actions, zap, Run workflow, job "preview", target `https://preview.carta-app.pages.dev`
Read the summary table (the job fails on any High) and note Mediums in the register

title: Probe the live Edge Functions' auth
why: The tests prove the handler code, not the deployed gateway and Supabase Auth.
how: `curl -i -X POST https://<ref>.supabase.co/functions/v1/plan-day -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{}'` and expect 401
Repeat with `-H 'Authorization: Bearer <an expired access token>'` and with the anon key as the bearer, both 401
`curl -i -X POST https://<ref>.supabase.co/functions/v1/stripe-webhook -H 'stripe-signature: t=1,v1=00' -d '{}'` and expect 400
Then close T1079-f

title: Decide the password and MFA policy
why: ASVS L2 forbids composition rules and asks for MFA for every account; today the form demands upper case, a digit and a symbol, and only the admin has TOTP.
how: Decide: drop the three composition rules and keep length plus the leaked-password check
Decide whether travellers get optional TOTP
Name the context words to refuse (Carta, the traveller's name and e-mail)

title: Set session lifetimes in Supabase
why: Sessions never time out and e-mail codes live an hour.
how: Supabase Dashboard, Authentication, Sessions: set an inactivity timeout and time-boxed sessions (both may need the Pro plan)
Authentication, Providers, Email: OTP expiry 600 seconds
Record the values in `_OPEN-auth-settings.md`

title: Close the unused GraphQL endpoint
why: Pg_graphql answers introspection on the project although the app never uses GraphQL.
how: Supabase Dashboard, Settings, API: remove `graphql_public` from the exposed schemas (or Database, Extensions: disable pg_graphql)
Then load the app and confirm nothing broke

title: Lake water class run
why: Fills water class and unknown swim flags on the wire.
how: `git lfs pull` or `python pipeline/harvest_bathing_water.py --refresh`
`python pipeline/lakes/fill_water.py --harvest-osm --apply`
Record before/after counts

title: Mountain route up run
why: Fills route up for summits with no route.
how: `python pipeline/mountains/fill_route_up.py --harvest --apply` (paced Overpass, resumable)
Record counts

title: Decide on four unmounted admin and AI files
why: They are tested but never shown, so they are either a lost feature or dead code.
how: Open the admin page and confirm AI calls and SLO panels are not there
Choose mount or delete
Tell the next task which

title: Build the ask index in the docs deploy
why: The box shows nothing until `index.js` exists in the built site.
how: In `.github/workflows/docs-site.yml` add `node scripts/docs/ask_docs.mjs build` before `mkdocs build`
Push
Confirm the box answers on the deployed site

title: Decide on dense vectors
why: BM25 misses paraphrases with no shared word; the static model could fix that.
how: `pip install model2vec`
Embed the 3,600 passages with `minishlab/potion-multilingual-128M`
Fuse with BM25 by RRF (k 60)
Keep it only if recall@5 or MRR rises on the question set without losing abstention

title: Run the model rewrite once
why: The gateway is not reachable from the cloud container.
how: With `CF_ACCOUNT_ID` and `CF_AI_TOKEN` set run `node scripts/docs/ask_docs.mjs "how do I restore a database backup?" --model`
Check the answer keeps its `[n]` marks

title: Label the 50 judge calibration texts
why: The text judge's verdicts count only after a human's labels pass kappa 0.7 (bootstrap low 0.5) and 90% planted recall; today they rest on seeded labels.
how: Open evals/truth/judge/labels.json and, for each of the 50 texts in text-sample.json, write supported, unsupported or contradicted per rubric (do not open text-sample-key.json), fill by and at
Run python -I scripts/validation/judge.py calibrate --write
Commit pipeline/judge/calibration/calibration-session.json

title: Run and calibrate the Gemini judge
why: The session judge needs a person at the keyboard; the Gemini judge can run every release, but only once it is calibrated on its own verdicts.
how: On the box with GEMINI_API_KEY set run python -I scripts/validation/judge.py gemini --items evals/truth/judge/text-sample.json --out pipeline/judge/calibration/judgments/gemini-YYYY-MM-DD.json (if gemini-pro-latest is refused, set AI_JUDGE_MODELS to a current Pro model id)
Run python -I scripts/validation/judge.py calibrate --verdicts that file --write
Commit both files

title: Check the price hand sample
why: The only check of absolute euros (a bias common to every country is invisible to Eurostat's indices).
how: Open data/reports/validation/prices/hand_sample.csv

For each row open the site by hand (Booking, Hostelworld or Airbnb for beds, the place's own menus for dinner), check-in 30 to 60 days out, one night, two adults for home and hotel3, one for dorm, sort by price and note the median of the first 20 results with taxes in found_eur, plus checked_on, site, n_seen and url
Then run `python -I scripts/validation/runner.py prices_sample --write-baseline --write` and commit the sheet and the result

title: Refresh the Eurostat price levels with the narrow categories
why: Beds are checked against restaurants and hotels together until accommodation alone is in.
how: `mkdir -p cache/eurostat_pli`
Do curl -sS "https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/api/dissemination/statistics/1.0/data/prc_ppp_ind?format=JSON&lang=EN&na_item=PLI_EU27_2020&ppp_cat=$c&sinceTimePeriod=2022" -o cache/eurostat_pli/$c.json
Done`
`python -I scripts/validation/layer_prices.py --refresh-reference --eurostat-dir cache/eurostat_pli`
`python -I scripts/validation/runner.py prices --write --write-baseline` and `python -I scripts/validation/layer_prices.py --table`
Commit data/reports/validation/prices/

title: Enter published fare examples and run the fares check
why: Flights have no open price reference, so the swept fares are not checked at all.
how: Add about 20 rows to data/reports/validation/prices/fare_examples.csv (one adult one way EUR fares read by hand from an airline or airport page, routes spread over short, medium and long, columns id,origin,dest,month,fare_eur,cc,source,url,read_on)
`mkdir -p cache/flights_wire`
For each origin `curl -sS https://data.carta-europetravel.com/data/flights/<IATA>.json -o cache/flights_wire/<IATA>.json`
`python -I scripts/validation/runner.py prices_fares --write-baseline --write`

title: Decide on the Numbeo anchors
why: Numbeo's terms forbid copying and derived works without a licence, and the June 2026 food baskets cite Numbeo pages.
how: Decide: license Numbeo, or replace the anchored baskets with Eurostat levels and national statistics prices
Tell the next prices task

title: Check the installed app on real phones
why: The offline trip and the install path are proven only in desktop Chromium, and iOS has no install prompt.
how: After the next deploy, open the site on an Android phone in Chrome, keep a trip, tap Add to home screen in My trips
Open the installed app, turn on airplane mode, reopen it and open the kept trip
Repeat on an iPhone in Safari through Share, Add to Home Screen
Note anything that fails in the T1169-b row

title: Decide the phone route for the stores
why: A Play or App Store listing needs the I-R3 choice (stay a PWA, wrap with Capacitor, or native).
how: Read ROADMAP I-R3
Pick the route
Record it as decision I-d in ROADMAP.md

title: Native review of drafted translations
why: The strings are machine-drafted and travellers read them.
how: Open docs/i18n/review.md
Have a native speaker read nl, de, fr, es, it, traveller-facing groups first
Send corrections

title: Pick one French register
why: Fr.js mixes tu and vous.
how: Decide tu or vous for French
Tell the next session

title: Beta test the Pass moment
why: It is the one designed paid moment in the journey and is off until the beta says it reads right.
how: Open a priced trip page with ?pm=on on a tester's phone and desktop
Watch whether "Not now" and "See the Trip Pass" feel fair
Set PASS_MOMENT = true in continent-app/src/pass/passMoment.js or tell the next task what to change

title: Register affiliate programmes and set the ids
why: Partner links only earn once an id exists; until then they stay plain.
how: Register Travelpayouts, Impact (Omio), GetYourGuide and Viator
Set VITE_TP_MARKER, VITE_OMIO_TRACKING_LINK, VITE_GYG_PARTNER_ID, VITE_VIATOR_PID in .env and the Cloudflare Pages project
Rebuild and look for the Partner link mark

title: Approve the disclosure wording
why: EU guidance wants a clear disclosure before the click.
how: Read /?legal=partner in all six languages
Run it against the I-R5 legal checklist
Confirm the PRODUCT.md wording (I-e)

title: Move the trails lab and its review app to the box
why: Trail runs and reviews stop needing the laptop, and T784-a can close.
how: After T1161-d, stop reviewing on the laptop
Hcloud volume create --name carta-trailslab --size 80 --server carta-orchestrator --format ext4
On the box mount it at /mnt/trailslab through fstab, add a 2 GB swapfile, sudo apt-get install -y docker.io docker-compose-v2 postgresql-client-18 and add carta to the docker group
Bash tools/trailslab/box/lab.sh env >> ~/.config/carta/env
Lab.sh check, lab.sh up, lab.sh restore, lab.sh status (the laptop's trips count)
Lab.sh review-build, lab.sh install, lab.sh review on, and from your machine ssh -N -L 4174:127.0.0.1:4174 -L 8011:127.0.0.1:8011 carta@<box>

title: Check the box lab under a real run
why: The 1.5 GB cap and the tuning are planning figures for a 4 GB box that also runs the pipeline.
where: docs/runbooks/build-box.md, "The trails lab on the box"
how: During the first monthly run with the lab up, run free -m and bash tools/trailslab/box/lab.sh status
Afterwards grep trails_ ~/carta/logs/pipeline_run.log for minutes and skips
If the box swaps hard, lower TRAILSLAB_MEM_LIMIT or rescale to a CAX21

title: Turn on the trip receipt share
why: The button is built but hidden behind a flag until someone has seen the image on real devices.
how: Open My trips with ?receipt=1 on a phone and a desktop
Open a saved trip's menu and choose Share the receipt
Check the figures against the trip page, then share or save once
If it reads right, set the default in shareReceiptOn to on (a next task can do the edit)

title: Make the real cheapest week calendars
why: The stays wire with the month curves lives on the data host and the owner box, not in the cloud container.
how: On the box, copy the stays files (data/stays-live/v1/{cc}.json, or stays/v1) into one folder
Run node scripts/share/share_assets.mjs --stays that-folder --png
Look at scripts/share/out/calendar/*.png and pick the places to share

title: Clear the credit line before publishing
why: The map and calendars quote aggregates of owner-run list price samples, whose terms are not settled (T1130-c).
how: Read the credit line printed on map_100.png
Decide whether "Carta's own samples of list prices" may be published and whether a source must be named
Note the answer in the register

title: Confirm gem identity provenance
why: An ODbL-only name or coordinate would break the CC BY promise.
how: Check how gem names and lat/lon were sourced (GeoNames match vs OpenStreetMap)
If OSM only, drop those columns for those rows in `FIELDS`
Rerun the tests

title: Build and publish the dataset
why: Publishing is the owner's.
how: Run `python scripts/open_data/export_open_dataset.py` on the box
Read the output
Create a public GitHub repo and upload `scripts/open_data/out/`, README.md, DATASHEET.md

title: Post the Show HN
why: Only once the free part needs no signup.
how: Confirm the free part has no signup
Fill the repo link
Post the draft

title: Run the monthly draft on the box
why: The draft needs a current wire and a pull request each month.
how: On the box run `python run_pipeline.py --only blog_drafts` after the monthly data run
Open a pull request with the new `content/blog/` files (a scheduled Claude Code routine can do this)
Add `--prose` to the task cmd if you want the Gemini opening

title: Approve the first post
why: Publishing is yours and the sample uses a wire dated 2026-06-07.
how: Regenerate the December draft on a fresh wire
Read and edit it
Set `status: published`
Run `python scripts/blog/check_draft.py`

title: Decide two proposed appeal changes
why: The 30-gap review found two villages scored on sights outside them, and scores are never hand-edited without you.
how: Open the rows Dannewerk and Bleggio Superiore in `data/reports/validation/ratings/gap_verdicts.json`
Check the Danevirke and Rango (Borghi piu belli) pages
Accept or reject 6.2 and 6.1 in `app_data/rubric_appeal.json` via the next rating task

title: Fetch the Wikivoyage status tiers
why: Turns the yes/no Wikivoyage reference into a four-tier one, the best quality signal the research found.
how: On your box run `python -I scripts/validation/layer_ratings.py fetch-wikivoyage`
Then `python -I scripts/validation/runner.py ratings --write`
Commit `data/reports/validation/ratings/sources/wikivoyage_status.json` and the new result

title: Add tourism board and best-of lists and Eurostat nights
why: The brief's extra references; the cloud cannot reach them.
how: Write one JSON per list (GNTB Top 100, European Best Destinations, others whose terms allow it) in `data/reports/validation/ratings/sources/lists/`, names, ranks and pages only
Save Eurostat city nights as `sources/eurostat_nights.json` keyed by place id
Rerun the ratings layer with `--write`

title: Decide on catalogue rows for listed places
why: Lonely Planet names Skanor-Falsterbo and Tipperary, and Tripadvisor and Lonely Planet name Sicily, Sardinia and the Veneto; Carta has no row for any of them.
how: Decide which (if any) get a row
File it as a catalogue task

title: Check the reference licences
why: The UNESCO and Tripadvisor terms limit republication, and T760's Tripadvisor file stores names and ranks.
how: Read UNESCO FAQ 126 and the Tripadvisor terms
Decide whether `data/rating/external/tripadvisor.json` stays in git or becomes a local-only input

title: Mountains reference export and baseline
why: The layer only has a 21-summit seed; the real check needs Wikidata heights and prominence plus national lists.
how: Run the Wikidata SPARQL (P31 mountain/peak in Europe with P2044, P2660, P625, by country batches under 60 s) to `data/reports/validation/mountains/wikidata_CC.csv` (columns id,name,lat,lon,cc,ele,prom,route,source)
Optionally add DoBIH and swisstopo CSVs as `national_*.csv`
Run `python -I scripts/validation/runner.py mountains --write --write-baseline`, then flip coverage and fact.height to hard in `layer_mountains.py` and add the fact.prom and agreement_tau checks

title: Rerun lakes on the box after the water fill
why: The T1186-a fill should lift water class and known swim rules; the baseline here is the pre-fill state.
how: After `fill_water.py --apply` run `python -I scripts/validation/runner.py lakes --write`
If coverage or class agreement moved on purpose rerun with `--write-baseline` and say why in a report

title: National lake lists
why: Fresher and extra sites beyond the EEA, and the only partly independent class check.
how: Drop CSVs (id,name,lat,lon,cc,class) into `data/reports/validation/lakes/national/` from France data.gouv (check each dataset's licence), SYKE, HaV
Rerun the lakes layer

title: Switch on the monthly blog branch
why: Without it `blog_pr` only prints what it would push, so no drafts reach a pull request.
how: Give the box a git credential that may push `blog-drafts-*` branches (not main)
Add `CARTA_BLOG_PR=1` to the box secrets file

After the first Saturday run open the pull request from the `blog-drafts-YYYY-MM` branch, read the drafts, set `status: published` on the ones to publish, run `python scripts/blog/check_draft.py`, merge

title: Verify the EuroVelo seed list
why: The whole coverage number rests on a list written from memory.
how: Open eurovelo.com route pages
Correct names, total km and country lists in `eurovelo.csv`
Set verified=yes
Rerun `python3 -I scripts/validation/runner.py cycling --write --write-baseline`

title: Add official km per country
why: Gives the length fact and error numbers.
how: Write `ev,cc,km` rows from the route pages
Rerun the layer

title: Add open official tracks
why: Gives the geometry fact.
how: Convert open data (France data.gouv, Sustrans, Swiss opendata) to `geom/EV6-AT.geojson` style files after reading their terms
Keep EuroVelo GPX out of git
Rerun

title: Add national network lists
why: National cycle networks are not compared yet.
how: Fill `national.csv` (id,name,cc,ref,net,km) from portals whose terms allow it
Rerun

title: Export climate normals and run the climate layer
why: The climate row cannot be validated without outside normals.
how: Build data/reports/validation/climate/normals.csv (id,name,cc,lat,lon,elev_m,month,tmax_c,tmin_c,precip_mm,source,period) from DWD CLIMAT 1991-2020 (read the licence first), about 300 stations across the countries
Run `python -I scripts/validation/runner.py climate --write --write-baseline`

title: Export Copernicus sea temperature and run the sea layer
why: The sea row needs an independent product.
how: With a free Copernicus Marine account export OSTIA REP monthly means 2003-2022 at about 300 coastal points to data/reports/validation/sea/cmems_sst.csv (id,name,cc,lat,lon,month,sst_c,source,period)
First finish T1097-a so Carta has sea temperatures
Run `runner.py sea --write --write-baseline`

title: Export Eurostat nights by month and run the crowds layer
why: The crowds row needs the national monthly profile.
how: Download tour_occ_nim (all countries, total accommodation, nights) to data/reports/validation/crowds/eurostat_nights_country_month.csv (cc,year,month,nights)
Confirm the reuse notice
Run `runner.py crowds --write --write-baseline`

title: Review the 30 largest gaps of each layer
why: D23 requires a verdict and a fix at the cause.
how: Run `python -I scripts/validation/layer_tables.py climate` (and sea, crowds)
Fill data/reports/validation/<layer>/gap_reviews.json as {id: {verdict, note}}
Rerun the tables

title: Rebuild the wire with climate.elev
why: The elevation guard on climate pairs is idle on the 2026-06-07 wire.
how: Run `apply_climate.py` and `sync-data.mjs` as in docs/SCHEMA.md, then rerun T1194-a

title: Run the trips timetable check on open GTFS feeds
why: The trips layer only covers 81 hand-read legs; the library-wide share of honest leg times needs the timetables.
how: Download the feeds to cache/gtfs/ (gtfs.de fv_free for DE, opentransportdata.swiss GTFS for CH, the Austria GTFS from data.oebb.at, the SNCF national and FlixBus GTFS from transport.data.gouv.fr, Entur NO, Trafiklab Sverige 2 with a free key, NTA Ireland with a key)

Run `python -I scripts/validation/trips_timetables.py legs` then `python -I scripts/validation/trips_timetables.py gtfs --date <a mid-season Tuesday> --feed cache/gtfs/de_fv.zip:DE --feed cache/gtfs/ch.zip:CH ...` (one --feed per zip with the countries it covers)
Run `python -I scripts/validation/runner.py trips --write --write-baseline` and commit data/reports/validation/trips/

title: Route the car legs on a self-hosted router
why: 1,021 car legs have no reference and the public OSRM server forbids bulk use.
how: Start a local OSRM (Docker osrm/osrm-backend on a Geofabrik Europe or per-country extract, car profile) or adapt tools/brouter
Run `python -I scripts/validation/trips_timetables.py osrm --url http://127.0.0.1:5000`
Rerun the runner with --write and commit

title: Decide the timetable sources with no open licence
why: Italy, Czechia, Poland, the Netherlands and Denmark have no confirmed open feed, Belgium needs a signed contract, Sweden and Ireland a free key.
how: Email gtfs@sncb.be for the SNCB licence if Belgium is wanted
Register the Trafiklab and NTA keys
For IT, CZ, PL, NL, DK confirm a feed's licence or leave them "no open reference"

title: Native review starting from the back-translation worst list
why: 11 drafted strings say something other than the English (one reverses a direction, two read "card" or "target" as map or destination) and the judge that passed the rest is lenient and uncalibrated.
how: Open docs/i18n/review.md, section Back-translation check
Have a native reader confirm or correct the "Fix these first" list, then the borderline list, then the traveller-facing groups
Send the corrections for a next task (T1196-b)

why: The session translators and judges are one model family, so a second family shows how much of the verdict is the model's own taste.
how: On the box with GEMINI_API_KEY set run python -I scripts/validation/judge.py gemini --items data/reports/validation/texts/items.json --out data/reports/validation/texts/verdicts-gemini-YYYY-MM-DD.json
Then python -I scripts/validation/texts_sample.py report --verdicts that file
Commit both and compare the per-stratum table with provisional-2026-11-07.md

title: First full link run on the box
why: The checker is proven on fixtures only; the real hosts are unreachable from the cloud.
how: On the box run `python pipeline/link_health.py run --limit 500`, read the totals, then let the weekly task continue
Commit the refreshed `continent-app/src/admin/linkHealth.json`

title: Confirm Wikimedia's bot policy
why: The pace (0.5 s per host) and user agent were set from secondary sources.
how: Read the Wikimedia User-Agent and Robot policy pages
Change `host_delay_s` and `user_agent` in `pipeline/config/link_health.yaml` if they differ

title: Photo check first run and baseline
why: The flag rate is measured but not gated until a baseline exists.
how: On the box: `python pipeline/photos/correctness.py --fetch-meta`
Read data/reports/photo_check/<date>.json (totals, review list)
`CARTA_PHOTO_CHECK=data/reports/photo_check/<date>.json python -I scripts/validation/runner.py photos --write --write-baseline`

title: Photo check vision tier run
why: Confirms the Gemini image calls, answers and cost (prices from aggregators only).
how: With GEMINI_API_KEY set: `python pipeline/photos/correctness.py --fetch-meta --vision gemini`
Check `vision.calls` and the tier 2 answers in the report
Compare the token use in AI_EVENTS_JSONL with https://ai.google.dev/pricing

title: Review the flagged heroes before applying
why: Replacements are automatic, taste is not (Starmer on Tiverton, Flag of Europe on Eu, a grizzly on Fur).
how: `python pipeline/photos/correctness.py --all --fetch-meta`
Read every `flag` result and its `replacement`
